reason_for_new_test: After observing old test errors, trace preservation and JSON response mode changed; old test remains archived, and v2 test questions were prepared separately.
criterion: Maximize manually reviewed fully grounded answers on 20 answerable dev cases, counting errors as unsuccessful; then fewer errors, then lower measured retrieval-only time. Both insufficient-evidence outputs must abstain. Applied before opening the new test results.
selection_explanation: TF-IDF, hybrid and hybrid_budget1600 tie at 13/20, each has zero errors and two system abstentions for unanswerable questions; TF-IDF has the lowest recorded retrieval-only dev time in the earlier same-corpus run (0.059 s versus 0.706 s and 0.798 s). Timings exclude loading and are a single run.
limitations: Small dev set, single non-independent reviewer, H08 ambiguity, coarse timing and temporal unanswerable cases. System-forced abstention and explicit model abstention must be distinguished.
